title: Walk to Nissan Stadium-Calm Retreat w/ Fenced Yard
description:
Walk to Nissan Stadium 🏈🎶 | Calm Retreat w/ Porch + Fenced Yard 🐾

Stay close to the action without staying in the chaos. This cozy historic bungalow is just a 5-minute walk to Nissan Stadium and a quick ride to Broadway. 🎸

Guests love the screened-in back porch 🌿, fully fenced dog-friendly yard, and thoughtful touches that make it feel like home. Enjoy private gated parking 🚗, an easy layout, and a peaceful place to unwind after concerts, games, or nights out!

The space
Historic bungalow that has all the southern charm with the modern amenities that will make your stay cozy and convenient! 

The jewel of the house is the 400 sq ft screened in porch that is a great gathering place for guests and a wonderful place to spend an evening grilling and watching a game on the big screen!

The two bedrooms are spacious and private with thick walls and large comfy queen beds. 

In addition to all the amenities inside the house, there's also private gated 2-car parking in the back that will allow you to easily come and go without having to fight for street parking.

We hope that you enjoy the house as much as we do and feel like it's a home away from home!
